ps: This website is operated by Pixelbrahma Design Studio Pvt Ltd ("Pixelbrahma", "we"). You can contact us at the email address shown on our Contact page.
When you use the contact form we collect the details you enter: your name, email, phone number, selected service, budget range and message.
If you accept analytics cookies, we may collect anonymous usage data about how pages are used. Analytics are off unless you consent.
We use your details to reply to your enquiry, prepare proposals and keep a record of our conversation. We do not sell your personal information.
Essential storage is used to remember your cookie choice. Analytics load only after you consent. You can change your choice at any time using the cookie settings link in the footer.
Form submissions are processed by the form service configured for this site. We do not load third-party maps on this website.
You may ask to access, correct or delete the personal information we hold about you by emailing us.
We may update this policy and will change the date shown on this page when we do.
